Writing

Preface

If your life were a movie, and people had been watching it up to this very moment, what would the audience be screaming at the screen for you to do?

Sit with it for a second. You will probably find that you already know the answer. You have known it for a while.

That answer is your hope.

So, can you face your hope?

To hope
is to risk.

About

Hi, I'm Bhavya.

I'm a Chartered Accountant who believes every number has a story behind it. I started telling stories early: I wrote my first book at 16. Today, as a GLS University alumnus, I'm invited into classrooms, panels and competitions at ICAI, H. L. College of Commerce, SKIPS University and more, to talk about finance, AI and the choices that shape a career. On LinkedIn, 6,000+ people follow Beyond Bhavya, where I turn companies, markets and policy into stories anyone can follow. My latest book, Face Your Hope, is built on one idea: to hope is to risk.
